column5: data_id is a sequential data index which should always increase in increments of 1. If the same sub_net contains multiple 0->n sequences then the sub_net will generate multiple terminals for each set. The max value of data_id should also be the same as the datasetmanager always just increases to increment%size. Shuffle value 1 ignores this order and in each update a random datapoint is given. The data_manager struct has a field dataset which is just a big ol vector of vectors of vectors that is read [TERMINALID][DATA_INDEX][BIT]. The values are pretty self explanatory
column6: but they are clamped in the same order as written. The terminal will always clamp from the smallest possible index of sub_net neurons.
